bio.p1: I build production-grade systems that work where others fail to deliver. My focus is mission-critical software for education and institutions, combining software engineering, instructional design, and systems thinking to ensure systems are adopted, trusted, and sustained.
bio.p2: I specialize in turning complex operational processes into simple, reliable digital systems used directly by non-technical users without friction.

items: Design and ship end-to-end systems used in real operations
Build software that prioritizes reliability, clarity, and adoption
Translate institutional workflows into maintainable digital architecture

items.text: Working with Faizal transformed how we handle administrative processes. He understood our constraints and built a system that our staff could use on day one, even with limited technical knowledge.
items.author: Ahmad Subhan

items.text: Beyond technical skills, Faizal brings instructional clarity to complex systems. He designs with the end user in mind—whether they're students or administrators—ensuring adoption without extensive training.
items.author: Suryadi, M.Pd
